description: This file sets up communication bridges between the Electron main and renderer processes, exposing certain IPC messages and RemoteBridge functionalities to the main world context for the renderer process.

methods.name: handleUpdateAvailable
methods.description: Registers a callback for the UpdateAvailable message from the main process.

methods.name: handlePerformAutomatedBackup
methods.description: Registers a callback for the PerformAutomatedBackup message.

methods.name: handleFinishedSavingBackup
methods.description: Registers a callback for the FinishedSavingBackup message.

methods.name: handleWindowBlurred
methods.description: Registers a callback for the WindowBlurred message.

methods.name: handleWindowFocused
methods.description: Registers a callback for the WindowFocused message.

methods.description: Registers a callback for the InstallComponentComplete message.
